saints.name: St. Paul VI
saints.title: Pope
saints.shortBlurb: The pope who carried the Second Vatican Council to its close and steered the Church through its reforms…
biography: Giovanni Battista Montini was born near Brescia in 1897 and served for decades in the papal secretariat of state before becoming Archbishop of Milan and, in 1963, Pope Paul VI. He guided the remaining sessions of the Second Vatican Council to their conclusion and oversaw the implementation of its decrees.

He was the first pope in modern times to travel abroad widely — to the Holy Land, to the United Nations, and to every continent — and in 1968 issued the encyclical Humanae Vitae. He died in 1978 and was canonized in 2018.
saints.knownFor: Guiding the Church through the close of the Second Vatican Council.
